summary: Named as a lookout site in Polk County on the tnlandforms.us Georgia list; Wikipedia describes a Signal Mountain in Rockmart. No source describes a tower or the site today.

facts.status_note: Only a tnlandforms.us list names this site. No source says whether a tower was built here or stands today.

evidence.supports: The source is a list of Georgia lookout towers
Lists a lookout site named signal mtn in Polk County, elevation 1286 (no unit given)
Signal Mountain in Rockmart is the most prominent mountain in Polk County, elevation 1,290 ft (393 m)
evidence.quote: The most prominent mountain in the county (as well as the fifth-highest) is Signal Mountain in Rockmart with a prominence of 360 ft (110 m) and an elevation of 1,290 ft (393 m) above sea level.

notes_for_editor: Confidence low. The list and Wikipedia both place a peak named Signal Mountain in Polk County, but no source ties the list's coordinates to Wikipedia's Rockmart peak, and no source describes a tower. Elevations differ slightly (list 1286 with no unit; Wikipedia 1,290 ft / 393 m). Search snippets (not read, not cited) named other peaks called Signal Mountain in Tennessee, New Hampshire and near Atlanta, so the coordinates should be checked before any use. The list's 'datasheet' tag is unexplained. Status and access in the brief stay unknown.
